name: phy.sim
description: Phy.Sim — an interactive physics textbook: notes, formulas, problems and 76 live simulations, from kinematics to particle physics. Runs in the browser, offline.

scripts.build:exe: cd packaging/windows && npm install && npm run dist
scripts.test: node tests/compat.js && node tests/calc.mjs && node tests/graphs.mjs && node tests/learn.mjs && node tests/lab.mjs && node tests/regress.js
